decision.reason: Rust now implements both Java tools endpoints and browser wrapper smoke passes, but no actual gateway route configuration exists in the repository; production canary cannot be executed or rolled back from repository state alone.
decision.safe_current_state: Java remains the only frontend target and Rust has no production traffic.
decision.next_required_work: Deployment must add and rehearse a complete /api/tools/** gateway route to Rust :18002 with an explicit Java :18001 rollback switch.

evidence_boundary: The getTwelvemonth wrapper is statically present but has no static page call. Direct Java/Rust HTTP comparison is not evidence of active browser traffic.
